title: Molecular Sieve Adsorber
model_title: Twin-Tower Molecular Sieve Adsorber (Gas Drying, TSA Regeneration)

introduction.definition: A molecular sieve adsorber removes water (and sometimes CO₂, H₂S or mercaptans) from gas using zeolite beads with uniform pores. Two towers work in turn: one adsorbs while the other is regenerated by hot gas (temperature swing). Very low dew points are achieved, which is essential before cryogenic gas processing.
applications: Natural gas drying before NGL/LNG plants
key_points: Cycle switching by time or breakthrough
introduction.summary: A molecular sieve adsorber dries gas (or removes CO₂/H₂S/mercaptans) using zeolite beads with precisely sized pores. Two towers alternate: one adsorbs while the other is regenerated with hot gas (temperature swing adsorption). Very low dew points are reached.

working_principle.characteristic_curve: Breakthrough curve: outlet water stays near zero until the MTZ reaches the bottom, then rises steeply.

temperature.title: Adsorption front and regeneration temperature
temperature.description: In the adsorbing tower water is held in the zeolite pores; the saturated zone grows from the inlet and the mass-transfer zone moves down until breakthrough, when the towers switch. Regeneration heats the bed (typically ~ 200–300 °C, TSA) to drive the water off, then cools it. Molecular sieves reach very low dew points (≈ −70 to −100 °C, < 1 ppmv water) — needed before cryogenic units.

video_tutorials.title: Molecular Sieve Adsorber — Introduction

script.narration: This module introduces the Molecular Sieve Adsorber.
A molecular sieve adsorber removes water (and sometimes CO₂, H₂S or mercaptans) from gas using zeolite beads with uniform pores.
Two towers work in turn: one adsorbs while the other is regenerated by hot gas (temperature swing).
Very low dew points are achieved, which is essential before cryogenic gas processing.
Typical applications include natural gas drying before NGL/LNG plants; air separation pre-purification; ethanol dehydration (vapour phase).
The cutaway reveals the internal construction.
The exploded view separates every component so each one can be tapped for its function, material and failure modes.
Next, watch the operation tutorial to see how it works.

video_tutorials.title: Molecular Sieve Adsorber — Maintenance

script.narration: Maintenance essentials for the Molecular Sieve Adsorber.
Monitor outlet dew point and bed ΔP.
Check regeneration temperatures and valve leak-tightness.
Replace sieve (typically 3–5 years).
Watch for early breakthrough: rising outlet water. Common cause: sieve ageing, incomplete regeneration, liquid carry-over.
Watch for valve leakage: wet gas bypass. Common cause: seat wear from thermal cycling.
Record every inspection so trends — vibration, temperature, leakage and performance — can be compared over time.
